name: Parus Business Centre
elevationDatum: Rigid local foundation y=0; real metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Two mapped controls fix rotation, baked into the geometry once. No terrain or Mercator stretch.
note: Parus’s pointed lens-shaped blue curtain wall rises above its broad five-storey podium, beside a pale rear service spine; a recessed mechanical crown and slender antenna complete the sail silhouette. Heights disagree: the main contractor gives 136 m and 156 m with antenna, whereas OSM/older operator-derived summaries give 133.1 m glass roof, 138 m crown and 149.6 m tip, and the outline itself is tagged 130 m. This model retains the mapped 133.1 m glazing and 137 m service-spine figure, places the inset mechanical roof at the contractor’s 136 m, and uses its 156 m tip. These mixed measurement definitions and the service-spine cap need independent dimensional review. Podium height 22 m follows the mapped tower min_height; window cadence and colors are original visual approximations. Neighboring Gulliver parts 153776632/300347479 are about 300 m away and are not owned. Billboards, lettering and trademarks are omitted. The pointed service-spine head rises from 136 to approximately 143 m, an original photo-based estimate above the mapped 137 m prism; it should be reviewed separately from the published main roof measurement. Cityscape: not tested; Full 3D world: not tested.
